Synthetic float32 grayscale TIFF inputs generated by
`tests/fixtures/generate_tiff_gray_float.py` with NumPy and tifffile 2025.6.11.
No external image content. The manifest pins every input SHA-256.

80 combinations cover classic/BigTIFF, both byte orders, black/white zero,
raw/Deflate strips, three orientations and three multi-page examples.
Five profile choices cover absent, linear, gamma 1.8, the exact working gray
profile and a malformed profile. UTF-8 XMP remains original in the project.
Gray samples include negative values, signed zero, small values and HDR to 1e8.
White-zero samples follow the decoder's float32 `1 - stored` interpretation;
rounding from this subtraction is accounted for independently in verification.
